name: ${UNIQUE:APIMSimilarTemplateCors}
description: A LITERAL resource (POST /payee/personal) sitting beside a TEMPLATED sibling (GET /payee/{id}) on the wildcard backend. No corsConfiguration, so the gateway computes Access-Control-Allow-Methods from the resource it RESOLVES for the pre-flight - which is what makes the resolution observable. The two resources also carry different authTypes (None vs Application & Application User) so the same path under a different verb resolves to a differently-secured resource.
